information.name: sms-telnyx
information.displayName: SMS notifications via Telnyx (with mass notices)
information.description: Sends event-based SMS (overdue, suspension, payments…) and mass notices by POP, tag, overdue status or all active clients through Telnyx. Handles STOP/START/HELP and forwards replies.
information.author: BitWind LLC

configuration.label: Telnyx API key (v2)
configuration.description: Mission Control → Account → API Keys. Starts with KEY…

configuration.label: Telnyx sending number
configuration.description: E.164, e.g. +17125551234. Must be on a messaging profile with an approved 10DLC campaign.

configuration.label: Telnyx webhook public key
configuration.description: Mission Control → Account → Keys & Credentials → Public Key. Used to verify inbound messages (STOP/HELP/replies).

configuration.label: Forward customer replies to
configuration.description: Your mobile, E.164. Replies other than STOP/START/HELP are texted here.

configuration.label: Message prefix
configuration.description: Prepended to every message so customers know who is texting, e.g. "YourISP: "

configuration.label: Opt-out footer
configuration.description: Appended to every message. Leave blank to omit (not recommended for mass notices).

configuration.label: HELP auto-reply
configuration.description: Sent when a customer texts HELP. Blank = no reply (Telnyx profile auto-response may handle it).

configuration.label: Send STOP/START confirmation texts
configuration.description: Leave off if your Telnyx messaging profile already auto-responds to opt-out keywords (default for 10DLC).

configuration.label: UISP (NMS) API token — for POP targeting
configuration.description: UISP → Settings → Users → App Tokens (read). Enables choosing recipients by POP/tower. Without it, use tag targeting.

configuration.label: Time zone
configuration.description: Used for quiet hours, dates in messages and log times, e.g. America/Chicago.

configuration.label: Block mass notices during quiet hours
configuration.description: Mass notices can't be sent 9 PM–8 AM in the time zone above unless marked urgent.

configuration.label: Estimated cost per message segment (USD)
configuration.description: Used for the cost estimate on the mass-notice page, e.g. 0.007 (Telnyx rate + carrier fee).
